name: Essentials for Claude Code
headline: Essentials for Claude Code - Automate Tasks
short_description: Loops and swarms on Claude Code's Task System. Both enforce exit criteria. swarm is faster with parallel queue execution.   Plans define what "done" means. Optional: Beads for persistent memory, Ralph TUI for dashboard.
author: GantisStorm

sections.overview:
Essentials for Claude Code provides three execution modes—loop (sequential), swarm (parallel subagents), and team (full Agent Teams instances)—all powered by Claude Code's native Task System. It solves the problem of AI agents claiming tasks are "done" when tests still fail, by enforcing exit criteria and looping until tests pass. Plans define what done means, with optional Beads integration for persistent memory across sessions and Ralph TUI for visual task progress dashboards. Dependencies flow automatically from plan files to task blockedBy lists, ensuring tasks execute in the correct order.
Fixing bugs that require multiple test-fix iterations until all tests pass
Building features with multi-phase dependency chains using plan files
Parallel refactoring across multiple API handlers with swarm mode
Spawning multiple Claude Code instances to collaborate on complex tasks via Agent Teams
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/GantisStorm/essentials-claude-code`
sections.usage:
```
Use Claude Code's Task System to automate [TASK_NAME] with a [PLAN_NAME] loop that enforces exit criteria: [EXIT_CRITERIA]. Execute tasks in [PARALLEL/SERIAL] mode using [swarm/loop]. Include [BEADS_NAME] for persistent memory if needed. Monitor progress with [Ralph TUI DASHBOARD] if available. Start with: 'Run [PLAN_NAME]'.
```
